# Zib Digital

> Australia's first hybrid agent SEO team. Senior strategists own the thinking, AI handles the scale. Commercial digital marketing — SEO, Google Ads, paid social, web — sold by outcomes, not activity reports. Operating since 2009.

Zib pioneered the partner model in Australian digital marketing: each partner runs their own territory with skin in the game and a dedicated senior digital manager handling day-to-day execution. No juniors on rotation, no handoffs to a service rep. Zib itself ranks for over 4,151 commercial keywords in the top 3 on zibdigital.com.au — the agency that sells SEO can demonstrate it.

## Free tools

- [30-second commercial audit](https://www.ziboutreach.com.au/audit): Drop a URL → 10-page technical crawl + senior strategist read + side-by-side hero rewrite + sample social ad creative. Streamed live, results appear in 30 seconds, no email required to see them.
- [ROI Calculator](https://www.ziboutreach.com.au/roi-calculator): Project monthly leads, revenue and ROI across SEO, Google Ads or paid social based on real margins and a campaign plan you control. Diagnostic-first.
- [AI Growth Simulator](https://www.ziboutreach.com.au/ai-growth-simulator): Live slider-driven tool modelling current vs AI-optimised revenue, profit, Year-1 ROI and payback. Adjust monthly leads, conversion rate, deal value and AI efficiency gains; export or share the scenario.

Industry playbooks with published, anonymised client results (names withheld on request; references available on a discovery call). Each page routes to the Zib partner who owns the vertical.

- [All industries](https://zibdigital.com.au/industries): The hub — every vertical Zib publishes a playbook for.
- [Trades & home services](https://zibdigital.com.au/industries/trades-and-home-services): Lead flow that doesn't depend on the weather, the season or luck.
- [Roofing & restoration](https://zibdigital.com.au/industries/roofing-and-restoration): Storm-surge campaigns plus the lead flow that runs between storms.
- [Tree & grounds care](https://zibdigital.com.au/industries/tree-and-grounds-care): Job-value qualification at the ad, not the driveway.
- [Pool & outdoor living](https://zibdigital.com.au/industries/pool-and-outdoor-living): Winning the summer in the autumn; compliance as an always-on line.
- [Automotive](https://zibdigital.com.au/industries/automotive): Dealerships and specialists winning the local query the carline site can't.
- [Dealerships](https://zibdigital.com.au/industries/dealerships): Per-showroom local presence, runout surges, fixed-operations marketing.
- [Aftermarket & specialist automotive](https://zibdigital.com.au/industries/aftermarket-and-specialist-automotive): Fitment-led search and high-ticket consideration.
- [Industrial & B2B supply](https://zibdigital.com.au/industries/industrial-and-b2b-supply): Specification-led search for manufacturers and suppliers.
- [SEO for real estate agents](https://zibdigital.com.au/seo-for-real-estate-agents): Beating other agents, not the portals.
